title: Stop Saying "Very Nervous"! 3 Better English Words #shorts
description:
Stop saying "very nervous". Use one of these words instead:
• Anxious: Mia is waiting for her job interview. She feels anxious.
• Jittery: Her hands start to shake. She feels jittery.
• On edge: Her heart is pounding. She feels on edge.

Comment your own word for "very nervous"!
